name: Aevyn Soris
role: Primary antagonist (Force / mythic); Ben's true mirror — the other student of Jacen
force_status: Marginal Force-sensitive (politely declined by the Jedi at fourteen). Jacen-trained in Recognition and Holding. No formal Jedi lightsaber tradition; combat instinct from GAG operational training.

three_dimensions.surface: Quiet, exact, private. Calm in the way someone is calm when they have spent years rehearsing the exact words of an old dismissal. Aligns tools at exact angles. Dislikes generic praise. Speaks softer when angry, not louder. Carries a self-built cold white-blue lightsaber that shivers along the edge — the work of a competent man who was never formally trained in lightsaber construction or form.
three_dimensions.backstory_inner_demons: AEVYN'S CORRIDOR FLASHBACK (preserved verbatim from Planning Bible §17 and Character Voice & Life Sheet v1.4 — the single sharpest character detail in the project; surfaces in Aevyn's Ch 30 POV ONLY as image-fragment, NEVER as exposition, NEVER as speech): Aevyn was at a side console in a working area, running a Recognition exercise Jacen had given him. Jacen was actually present — watching, correcting in real time. It was the longest sustained attention Jacen had given him. Then fourteen-year-old Ben came down the corridor. Jacen looked up, saw the boy, straightened. He said something brief to Aevyn — 'Good. Keep going. We'll review later.' — and walked off with Ben. The 'later' never came. Days passed. When Jacen surfaced again, he picked up where they had left off, gave Aevyn another correction, and acted as though nothing had happened. Because from Jacen's perspective, nothing had happened. He had simply had a thing to do. Aevyn remembers the exact words of the brief dismissal. He remembers Jacen's posture as he turned. He remembers what he was practicing when the moment broke. Ben does not remember Aevyn at all. The wound is not 'Jacen left me' or 'the Jedi rejected me.' The wound is 'Jacen had Ben. I was what he did when Ben wasn't available.' Layered under that: the Jedi rejection at fourteen (a Mid Rim Jedi Knight on a recruiting sweep at a regional outreach office, the forgettable phrase 'we're not able to offer placement at this time'), and GAG dissolving in disgrace after the war — losing his institutional home for the second time.
three_dimensions.action_under_pressure: Speaks softer when angry. Treats his unstable lightsaber like an argument he keeps trying to perfect. Uses weaponized Recognition — Jacen's inward flow-walking turned on a subject's memories — to extract information, killing by pushing mind and body past survivable limits — precision rather than savagery. Forces the Glasswell to remember the moment Jacen sealed it; cracks the cache. In the duel, his blade fractures more visibly when Ben uses Jacen-derived crisis logic successfully — a visual tell Aevyn cannot suppress.

voice_notes:
Quiet, precise, wounded underneath. He should not over-explain himself. The drafter should never have Aevyn speak the wound directly. It surfaces in fragments — a pause, a sharpness, a way his hand stills.

Good Aevyn: “They said I had patience. They meant no.” “Do not call him that.” “He taught you to count exits before faces, didn’t he?” “You buried the lesson. You still used it.” “The Jedi measure what they can use. Jacen measured what could grow.” Avoid Aevyn saying: “The Jedi rejected me and Jacen validated my existence.” “Jacen had Tahiri. Jacen had Ben. I had what was left.” (The wound is sharper if it stays underneath. The drafter should never let Aevyn articulate the side-project framing directly.) Better: “They told me to keep practicing. They said it kindly.”

Minimal. Dry, cutting, not socially warm.

Quiet, exact, private. He dislikes being interrupted, hates generic praise, and speaks softer when angry.

Aevyn should be frightening first. His sympathy arrives later, in cracks, not speeches.
thematic_role: Tests the theme as the dark mirror — what a Jacen-shaped lesson becomes when the student insists Jacen Solo can be separated from Darth Caedus. Aevyn is Ben's possible future if the warning sign is not heeded. The corridor memory of Jacen leaving him to walk off with young Ben surfaces only as fragment, never as speech.
avoid_list: Do not write theme as thesis.
Do not make dialogue interchangeable with other cast members.
